title: LPM Repo Config
description: Shared per-repo config (.lpm.yml at the project root). Project-identity fields (name, root, parent_name, ssh) live in each user's project file, not here. Field shapes mirror project-config.schema.json — keep them in sync when adding fields.

extends.description: Templates to layer underneath this config. Refs are bare names (resolved from ~/.lpm/templates/<name>.yml), absolute paths, or paths relative to this file. The first item wins on collision; this file overrides all of them.

actions.description: One-shot commands exposed as buttons or menu items.

profiles.description: Named subsets of services. `default` is used when no profile is selected.

zones.description: Framed groups of buttons in the header or the footer, 1 to 3 rows tall. An action sits in a zone when its "display" is the zone's name. An entry with "rows" declares the zone; an entry without it only adjusts a zone declared in another config file.

propertyNames.errorMessage: Invalid zone name. It can't be empty, contain ":" or "/", or be "header", "footer", "menu" or "button".

envMap.description: Environment variables passed to the process.

rows.description: Height in rows of the bar the zone sits in. An entry with "rows" declares the zone.

label.description: Name shown in menus. Defaults to the zone's key.

display.description: The bar the zone sits in: "header" (default) or "footer". Footer zones share the footer's position numbering with footer buttons.

position.description: Optional sort key among the items of the zone's bar. Lower values render first; entries without a position fall back to alphabetical order. Floats are allowed so items can be inserted between existing positions without renumbering.

layers.description: Keyed layers a zone can slide between; dots show with two or more. A button joins one with its "layer" key. A button with no "layer", or one naming a layer the zone doesn't have, shows in the first layer (lowest position, ties by key).

propertyNames.errorMessage: Invalid layer key. It can't be empty or contain ":" or "/".

label.description: Name shown left of the dots while the layer is showing. Without one, only the dots show.

position.description: Sort key among the zone's layers. Lower values come first; ties break by key.

name.description: Key used when the service is defined in array form.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to project root or absolute.

portConflict.description: What to do when this service's port is busy at start. "ask" (default) prompts before freeing it; "free" frees it automatically; "fail" refuses to start.

dependsOn.description: Other services this one needs. They start first (in dependency order) and are pulled in automatically whenever this service starts. No readiness wait; unknown names or cycles are errors.

name.description: Key used when the action is defined in array form.

emoji.description: Optional emoji shown as the action's icon and on the terminal tab it launches.

shortcut.description: Optional keyboard shortcut that runs the action while the project is open, e.g. "cmd+shift+b". Must include cmd or alt.

prompt.description: Prompt handed to the AI agent the command launches (claude, codex, ...), submitted once the agent is ready.

port.description: Port(s) the action wants free before it runs. Accepts a single port, an inclusive range string like "3002-3010", or a list mixing both. Busy ports are handled per "portConflict".

portConflict.description: What to do when a declared port is busy. "ask" (default) prompts before freeing it; "free" frees it automatically; "fail" refuses to run.

display.description: How the action appears in the UI. Defaults to "header" when omitted. "footer" pins it to the footer; any other name puts it in the zone of that name (see "zones"). "menu" is still accepted but no longer suggested.
display.errorMessage: Invalid "display" value. Use "header", "footer" or a zone name without ":" ("button" → use "header").

layer.description: Which layer of its zone the button sits in. Applies only when "display" names a zone with layers. Without it, or naming a layer the zone doesn't have, the button shows in the zone's first layer.

primary.description: For an action with sub-actions: which sub-action the button's main part shows and runs. "last-used" follows your most recent pick; a sub-action key always shows that one. The arrow still opens the full list.

reuse.description: Reuse an existing terminal if one is open.

mode.description: Where the action runs on SSH projects. "remote" (default) runs over ssh on the host; "sync" rsyncs ssh.dir into a local mirror, runs the action locally, then rsyncs changes back — useful when you want local tools (e.g. your local Claude Code) to act on remote files.

position.description: Optional sort key. Lower values render first; entries without a position fall back to alphabetical order. Floats are allowed so items can be inserted between existing positions without renumbering.

name.description: Key used when the terminal is defined in array form.

emoji.description: Optional emoji shown as the terminal tab's icon.

prompt.description: Prompt handed to the AI agent the command launches (claude, codex, ...), submitted once the agent is ready.

port.description: Port(s) the terminal wants free before it launches. Accepts a single port, an inclusive range string like "3002-3010", or a list mixing both. Busy ports are handled per "portConflict".

portConflict.description: What to do when a declared port is busy. "ask" (default) prompts before freeing it; "free" frees it automatically; "fail" refuses to launch.

display.description: How the terminal appears in the UI. Defaults to "header" when omitted. "footer" pins it to the footer; any other name puts it in the zone of that name (see "zones"). "menu" is still accepted but no longer suggested.
display.errorMessage: Invalid "display" value. Use "header", "footer" or a zone name without ":" ("button" → use "header").

layer.description: Which layer of its zone the button sits in. Applies only when "display" names a zone with layers. Without it, or naming a layer the zone doesn't have, the button shows in the zone's first layer.

primary.description: For an action with sub-actions: which sub-action the button's main part shows and runs. "last-used" follows your most recent pick; a sub-action key always shows that one. The arrow still opens the full list.

position.description: Optional sort key. Lower values render first; entries without a position fall back to alphabetical order.

actions.description: Nested sub-actions for split-button style terminals.
